description: This file defines a C# class 'Css' within the 'BlazorAdmin.JavaScript' namespace. The class provides methods to interact with JavaScript runtime for showing and hiding body overflow styles in a web application, utilizing JS interop in a Blazor context.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class facilitating JS interop to manipulate CSS styles related to body overflow in a Blazor application.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: An asynchronous method that invokes a JavaScript function to show the body's overflow.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: An asynchronous method that invokes a JavaScript function to hide the body's overflow and returns the result as a string.
